items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 2:1
items.html: It has already been explained in the preceding answer 88, the reason for the absence of the middle line in all the seven lower [Sefirot] of the Partzuf NHY of the females of Atzilut: because they are the discernment of BON, built only from the vessels of Nekudim, and do not have within them the vessels and corrections of the new MA, which came out in Atzilut; see there. It was also explained there that the correction of the middle line in the middle sections of the Partzuf NHY, in the male Partzufim of Atzilut, was renewed only after the world of Nekudim, in the pregnancies of the Partzufim of Atzilut in the belly of Ima. It is also known that there is no further difference between male and female except in the discernments of their Yesodot. Thus, the building of the female Partzuf was emanated and came out in the world of Nekudim, while the building of the male Partzuf came out afterward, in the world of Atzilut. Thus the daughter was born before the sons. (p. 916, Sub Header, ‘And with’)
